newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean KDB has 16.4 bln won loans to Sammi Steel.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean KDB has 16.4 bln won loans to Sammi Steel.

text.p: The state-run Korea Development Bank (KDB) said on Thursday it had outstanding loans of 16.4 billion won to troubled Sammi Steel Co.
A KDB statement said its outstanding loans to Sammi Steel fell sharply from 354.2 billion won at the end of February as the steelmaker paid back 337.8 billion won last week.
The steelmaker was able to make the repayment following the sale of its specialty iron rod production business last month to Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd. The deal was valued at 719.4 billion won.
Sammi Group's major units -- Sammi Steel and Sammi Corp -- filed with a Seoul court for protection from creditors on Tuesday.
Sammi Steel defaulted on payments of promissory notes valued at about 1.8 billion won and Sammi Corp defaulted on 850 million won worth, creditor banks said.
Sammi Steel had liabilities of 1.45 trillion won at the end of 1996 against assets of 1.53 trillion won, according to company figures.
